title: Sequential Conditional Independence Testing with Machine Learning Models
summary: Conditional independence testing is a ubiquitous problem in scientific discovery. The widely employed model-X assumption shifts the modelling burden from the dependence of the output on the inputs to the dependencies within the inputs. Log-optimal e-variables have been studied in this setting, but it remains unclear how to incorporate machine learning models into their design. Other approaches test exchangeability directly, yielding an e-variable with lower power in theory but, surprisingly, higher power in practice.
